# stb_image

Unmodified `stb_image.h` from https://github.com/nothings/stb at commit
`d14d46f6b44456eb88beac58cba833a4135d4c89` (retrieved 2026-11-06).

SHA256: `594c2fe35d49488b4382dbfaec8f98366defca819d916ac95becf3e75f4200b3`

The public-domain/MIT license is included in the header. Lunar compiles only PNG
support, without stdio, in `src/c/libs/pngimage_wrap.c`. File size and dimensions
are checked before decoding; output uses a premultiplied-alpha area filter.
